sections.title: Treating customers *like family*

image.alt: A black 1931 Ford Model A coupe parked under the dealership canopy

body: Wayne Heath Automotive Company has served Aiken for more than 41 years as a family owned and operated small business. Customers come back, and the online reviews say why.
Our inventory is quality pre-owned vehicles that were locally owned. We run a CARFAX report on every one, and many include a warranty.
list: Ask for Wayne, Mareese or Chase
Between Sam’s Club and Walmart on Richland Avenue West

items.title: Look
items.text: See what’s on the lot online, or tell us what you’re looking for.

items.title: Drive it
items.text: Come by Monday to Friday, 9 to 5:30, and take it for a spin.

items.title: Drive home
items.text: Pay, finance or trade in, and leave with the keys.

items.q: Where do your cars come from?
items.a: They were locally owned. We don’t buy auction cars, and every car gets a CARFAX report.

items.q: Can I trade in my car?
items.a: Yes. We buy, sell and trade, so bring your car along when you come to look.
Yes. Ask about finance options, or start a credit application before you come in.
At 3900 Richland Avenue West in Aiken, between Sam’s Club and Walmart.

sections.title: Come see the lot
sections.text: Open Monday to Friday, 9 to 5:30. Call ahead and we’ll have the car ready.
